summary: CRT SEH scope-table unwinder (_local_unwind core). Walks the 3-DWORD scope table referenced at a1+0x8 while the current trylevel at a1+0xC is neither -1 nor the target level a2, advancing the stored trylevel each iteration and invoking each scope entry's registered unwind handler (guarded by a disposition word) before returning a1.

operations.description: Load the scope-table pointer from a1+0x8.
Load the current trylevel from a1+0xC.
Iterate the scope table while the current trylevel is neither -1 nor the target level a2.
Break the loop when trylevel equals -1 (no scope left) or equals the target level a2 (unwind target reached).
Index the 3-DWORD scope entry: entry = 3 * trylevel; the first DWORD of the entry holds the next trylevel.
Advance the stored trylevel at a1+0xC to the next scope entry.
When the scope entry's second DWORD (disposition) is zero, report via sub_58893A and invoke the registered unwind handler at the entry's third DWORD.
Call sub_58893A(257) to signal the unwind action for the current scope entry.
Invoke the unwind handler with the SEH ExceptionList and the FlagCheckHandler callback (0x00588884).
Called by ScriptFrameProcessor (0x0058895C), LocalUnwindWrapper (0x00588A19), LongjmpMSVCCRT (0x0058A770) and SEHWrapperAroundCRTFunctionCall (0x005938B4) as the shared unwind core.
